neighbours.label: The letters "cass" at the start of a word, in any language and sense: cassette, casserole, cassava, cassock, French casser/cassé, names Cass, Cassis, Cassandra, Cassius (also CASSETTE in caps). Quiet for look-alikes without the double s (case, cash, cashier, cast, castle, casino, casket, casa), for "cass" inside a word (Picasso, molasses), and for breaking verbs without "cass" (brisé, shattered, rompió). Weak on Kassel and on the name Cassidy.
